prompt:
Create ONE finished premium category-cover image for the Arabic social knowledge game Maydan, category 'جوجوتسو كايسن'. Landscape 4:3 artwork.
Medium: original graphic action illustration.
Intentional palette: purple, cyan, black.
Scene: An empty urban alley filled with abstract violet energy ribbons, bold perspective, no characters or symbols.
Make this a distinctive complete environment or illustration, not an isolated object on an ivory studio background. Sophisticated, inviting art for ages 16+, strong readable composition at 160px width. Keep key features within the central 70% and leave the upper corners relatively quiet for game badges. Full-bleed image, no decorative border, no text, no typography, no watermark, no UI, no logos. Do not make a multi-image grid or contact sheet. The category name is rendered separately by the app.

review.method: shipped cover CSS; baseline and replacement side by side
